description: CsNaSnF₆ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbcn space group. There are two inequivalent Cs sites. In the first Cs site, Cs is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten F atoms. There are a spread of Cs-F bond distances ranging from 3.14-3.54 Å. In the second Cs site, Cs is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten F atoms. There are a spread of Cs-F bond distances ranging from 3.05-3.48 Å. Na is bonded to six F atoms to form NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent SnF₆ octahedra and  an edgeedge with one SnF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 23-44°. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.49 Å. Sn is bonded to six F atoms to form SnF₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaF₆ octahedra and  an edgeedge with one NaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 23-44°. There are a spread of Sn-F bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.02 Å. There are six inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Cs, one Na, and one Sn atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two Cs, one Na, and one Sn atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Cs, one Na, and one Sn atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Cs, one Na, and one Sn atom. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Cs, one Na, and one Sn atom. In the sixth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Cs, one Na, and one Sn atom.
